_comment: A synthetic naming profile, standing in for a real library's.
This target must not need a real library to test itself: what ACME is called
in {{Lang}} is ACME's question, asked in ACME's own distribution repository
(see docs/distribution-repositories.md). These tests exercise the mechanism —
alias resolution, acronym casing, ambiguity, drift — against a library that
does not exist, which is the point.
Shapes worth covering, one per real-world case:
acme_storage      an alias that resembles its submodule
acme_streamflow   an alias that resembles nothing
pipelines         a submodule with no vendor prefix at all
